next_step: Deliver perf benchmark report + config proposal; schedule canary POC week of 2026-03-24
notes: Customer summary: mid-market fintech platform building real-time personalized offers and chat support; high sensitivity to latency + token cost.
Primary workloads: conversational support (multi-turn chat), embedding-based document search, and on-the-fly reranking for product recommendations.
Perf targets: P95 end-to-end token latency <75ms for short-chat flows (<=256 tokens), sustained 350-450 QPS for embeddings/reranking pockets.
Cost constraints: Monthly token budget is capped; engineering asks for batching/caching/quantization levers to reduce per-token unit cost without degrading QA metrics.
Optimization interest: Redwood Optimize recommended — want automated batching policy suggestions, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles (8-bit/4-bit) to test model tradeoffs.
Benchmark ask: request full perf matrix across: model variants (base/quant), batch sizes, KV-cache hit rates, and 99/95/50 latency percentiles; include TCO estimate per million tokens.
Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML), KMS key encryption (customer-managed), audit logs with 1-year retention, and EU data residency for a subset of customers.
Deployment preference: Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput + Private/VPC for regulated product lines; will consider hosted for non-sensitive workloads.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 call: "We need sub-100ms token latencies for the UI — but we can't sacrifice accuracy for cheapness. Show us the compromise."
POC scope agreed: 2-week canary on dedicated pool (NVIDIA H100 equiv), perf sweep with Redwood Optimize suggestions, and an A/B on quantized vs float models for accuracy regression checks.
Acceptance criteria: P95 <= 75ms, quality delta <= 1.5% on NLU intent accuracy, cost reduction >= 30% vs current baseline after batching + quantization.
Internal note: legal flagged data residency clause; procurement timeline contingent on legal signoff (see linked_drive_docs).
